name: Universal Standard

prices.note: Public Shopify feed of /collections/denim (192 products, read with curl, StylodexBot UA): 158 jeans listings (one per wash), none with a compare-at price above the price; 34 non-jean items (denim-look pants, jackets, chambray shirts, shorts) excluded. Low end: Seine High Rise Skinny Jeans ($118, 27, 30 and 32 inch inseams); Bae Boyfriend Crop Jeans $138; top $188.

notes: Our Story page: 'Where style is your only filter. Sizes 00-40. Fashion for all of US. As we are.' Sizes listed from '4XS 00-0' to '4XL 38-40'. Mentions 'premium Peruvian cotton'; no manufacturing location stated.

Shipping policy: 'All United States orders receive free standard (5-10 business days) shipping!'; expedited $25; 'Free shipping is guaranteed on all full-price purchases' (promotions and final sale may carry a fee). International: 'We ship to most countries' via Global-e (DHL), duties collected at checkout; ships_to stores only the US, the one destination the policy names.

Refund policy: 30 days from the shipping date for non-final-sale items, unworn with tags; Happy Returns drop-off $4.50 fee, mail-in $7.50 per order; exchanges and store credit free. Homepage: 'Fit Liberty: Free Exchanges For 1 Year'.
Wikipedia infobox: founded 2015 by Alexandra Waldman and Polina Veksler; HQ New York City; private.
Denim inseams sold separately for several styles (e.g. Seine High Rise Skinny Jeans 27, 30 and 32 inch).
